The smell of books and ink assails the young man's nose, dust litters the room. A forgot nook in the great complex which makes up the People's Megalopolis, and he is but a cog in its great engine. The man-made soul of the Perfect nation. But this cog was loose, he flittered through pages of forgotten history, one thing is consistent. 35PTR is missing; the pages in the literal book are ripped out at the seams. He slides the book back amongst the other great piles, and then a paper falls upon him, touching his nose before continuing its path to the ground. He stopped it mid-flight and read one word, Valonia.
